shellCommands.command: curl -sS http://localhost:3000/ | head -c 400; echo; echo "---"; curl -sS -D - -o /tmp/add.html -X POST http://localhost:3000/books -d 'title=The+Left+Hand+of+Darkness&author=Ursula+K.+Le+Guin&notes=Slow+start%2C+then+excellent.'; echo "---BODY---"; head -c 200 /tmp/add.html; echo; echo "---JSON---"; cat data/books.json
node server.js > /tmp/books-server.log 2>&1 & echo $!; sleep 0.3; cat /tmp/books-server.log; ss -ltnp | head -20 || netstat -ltnp | head -20

curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "home:%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:3000/; curl -sS -D - -o /tmp/add.html -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3000/books --data-urlencode "title=The Left Hand of Darkness" --data-urlencode "author=Ursula K. Le Guin" --data-urlencode "notes=Slow start, then excellent."; echo "==== BOOK PAGE ===="; LOC=$(python3 -c "import pathlib; t=pathlib.Path('/tmp/add.html').read_text(); import re; m=re.search(r'Location: (\\S+)', open('/dev/stdin').read())" 2>/dev/null); curl -sS -D /tmp/headers -o /tmp/add.html -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3000/books --data-urlencode "title=The Left Hand of Darkness" --data-urlencode "author=Ursula K. Le Guin" --data-urlencode "notes=Slow start, then excellent."; grep -i location /tmp/headers; echo "==== JSON ===="; cat /workspace/data/books.json

curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:3000/books/15fba67d-5e47-4dd8-a1b0-7d93ea2b93a8 | python3 -c "import sys,re; html=sys.stdin.read(); text=re.sub(r'<[^>]+>',' ',html); text=re.sub(r'\s+',' ',text); print(text)"; echo "==== FINISH ===="; curl -sS -D - -o /dev/null -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3000/books/15fba67d-5e47-4dd8-a1b0-7d93ea2b93a8/finish | head -5; echo "==== HOME TEXT ===="; curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:3000/ | python3 -c "import sys,re; html=sys.stdin.read(); text=re.sub(r'<style>.*?</style>',' ',html,flags=re.S); text=re.sub(r'<[^>]+>',' ',text); text=re.sub(r'\s+',' ',text); print(text)"; echo "==== MISSING ===="; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:3000/books/nope
